rationale: Second scenario for the same liveness duty, extending the confirmed enqueue to what follows it: the harness takes the instance the executor's timeout path enqueued and hands it to the recovery entry, then reports that the record is preparing with a Prepare emitted (the local construction run shows preparing true, one self reply and 34 bytes sent after the enqueue at about 12.9 seconds). This closes the gap between 'the timeout enqueues the blocked instance' and 'recovery actually starts', which the rejected-round case depends on. The trusted runner and a fresh correspondence review decide the formal outcome.
